# Impobarato

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Appliance retailer in Uruguay with an online store on the Fenicio platform and a branch in Montevideo. Sells kitchen, refrigeration, laundry, TV and audio, climate and small home appliances. States free shipping across the country for customers with an account; no minimum purchase is stated.

*ES:* Comercio de electrodomésticos en Uruguay con tienda online sobre la plataforma Fenicio y una sucursal en Montevideo. Vende cocina, refrigeración, lavado, TV y audio, climatización y pequeños electrodomésticos. Indica envío gratis a todo el país para clientes con cuenta, sin mínimo de compra indicado.
